meta.name: gtm-motions
meta.description: Identify the best GTM motions and tools across 7 motion types: Inbound, Outbound, Paid Digital, Community, Partners, ABM, and PLG. Use when selecting marketing channels, choosing between inbound and outbound strategy, or planning cross-channel campaigns.

copy.tagline: 选择最佳GTM策略与营销渠道组合
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品或活动制定市场推广策略。
copy.tagline_en: Select the best GTM motions and marketing channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to choose marketing channels and plan go-to-market strategies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的产品、市场和团队，从7种GTM策略（如入站、出站、付费广告等）中评分并推荐最适合的2-4种组合，给出工具建议和90天执行计划。
howto.when: 当你询问选择营销渠道、比较入站与出站策略、或规划跨渠道营销活动时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析我的SaaS产品适合哪种GTM策略。
say.note: Claude会要求你提供产品描述、目标客户等信息。

say.text: 比较入站营销和PLG哪个更适合我的产品。
say.note: Claude会基于你的产品特点给出评分和建议。

say.text: 给我一个90天的GTM执行计划。
say.note: Claude会输出包含里程碑、工具和预算的详细计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your product, market, and team, then scores 7 GTM motions (e.g., Inbound, Outbound, Paid Digital) and recommends the best 2-4 combinations, along with tool suggestions and a 90-day execution plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about selecting marketing channels, comparing inbound vs outbound strategies, or planning cross-channel campaigns.

say_en.text: Analyze which GTM motion fits my SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product description, target customer, etc.

say_en.text: Compare inbound marketing vs PLG for my product.
say_en.note: Claude will score and recommend based on your product.

say_en.text: Give me a 90-day GTM execution plan.
say_en.note: Claude will output a detailed plan with milestones, tools, and budget.
